environment.description: Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on EC2 instance, connecting to PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance. Database connection uses role 'inventory_app' which has been granted ALL PRIVILEGES on the inventory schema including SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and DDL operations. Application is exposed via direct port mapping on port 8080 with no reverse proxy or WAF. JDBC connection string: jdbc:postgresql://prod-db.internal:5432/inventory_db with user=inventory_app.

config.db_privileges: ALL PRIVILEGES ON SCHEMA inventory (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER)
config.network: Direct EC2 port 8080 exposure, no WAF
